Promotion stage, 2nd of 8 (promoted) | website = {{URL|http://www.academica-oaf.pt}} }} The '''Associação Académica de Coimbra – Organismo Autónomo de Futebol''' ('''AAC-OAF'''), also referred to as '''Académica de Coimbra''' ({{IPA|pt|ɐkɐˈðɛmikɐ ðɨ kuˈĩbɾɐ}}) or simply '''Académica''', is a professional [[association football|football club]] based in [[Coimbra]], Portugal. As of the 2023–24 football season in Portugal, the club competes in the [[Liga 3 (Portugal)|third division]] of the [[Portuguese football league system]], and hosts home games at the [[Estádio Cidade de Coimbra]] which is owned by the local municipal government. Académica also played at the [[Estádio Sérgio Conceição]] at the start of the 2023–24 season.{{Cite web |last=DigitalRM |date=6 June 2023 |title=Manutenção da Académica de Coimbra na Liga 3 para 2023/2024! - Campeão das Províncias |url=https://www.campeaoprovincias.pt/noticia/manutencao-da-academica-de-coimbra-na-liga-3-para-2023-2024 |access-date=7 November 2023 |website=Campeão das Províncias - Website Campeão das Províncias |language=pt |archive-date=7 November 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231107233839/https://www.campeaoprovincias.pt/noticia/manutencao-da-academica-de-coimbra-na-liga-3-para-2023-2024 |url-status=live }}{{Cite web |title=Câmara negoceia acordo com Académica para ter maior tutela do estádio de Coimbra |url=https://www.record.pt/futebol/futebol-nacional/liga-3/detalhe/camara-negoceia-acordo-com-academica-para-ter-maior-tutela-do-estadio-de-coimbra |access-date=7 November 2023 |website=record.pt |language=pt-PT |archive-date=7 November 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231107233837/https://www.record.pt/futebol/futebol-nacional/liga-3/detalhe/camara-negoceia-acordo-com-academica-para-ter-maior-tutela-do-estadio-de-coimbra |url-status=live }} It also has a [[futsal]] department with men's and women's teams. The club's name derives from the footballing division of the [[Associação Académica de Coimbra]], officially known as the Associação Académica de Coimbra - Secção de Futebol (AAC-SF)'','' which fields its own amateur football teams as a second incarnation starting in 1977 and belongs to the student association of the [[University of Coimbra]] like the professional AAC-OAF which is however an autonomous organization inside the student association and owns the entire heritage and historical records formerly belonging to AAC-SF until 1974.{{Cite web |last=SAPO |title=Em Coimbra, há uma outra Académica feita de estudantes, sem salários nem prémios |url=https://www.sapo.pt/noticias/atualidade/em-coimbra-ha-uma-outra-academica-feita-de_56c9fe30ba5cf0f72bd3f544 |access-date=5 November 2023 |website=SAPO |language=pt |archive-date=5 November 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231105114920/https://www.sapo.pt/noticias/atualidade/em-coimbra-ha-uma-outra-academica-feita-de_56c9fe30ba5cf0f72bd3f544 |url-status=live }} Despite being founded in 1887 as a student organisation, following the merger of ''Clube Atlético de Coimbra'' (founded in 1861) and ''Academia Dramática'' (founded in 1837), the football section of the Associação Académica de Coimbra was only established in 1911, making it one of the oldest active clubs in Portugal and the Iberian Peninsula. The club have won the [[Taça de Portugal]] twice, in [[1938–39 Taça de Portugal|1938–39]] and [[2011–12 Taça de Portugal|2011–12]]. In [[1966–67 Primeira Divisão|1966–67]], they achieved their highest position of runner-up in the [[Primeira Liga]] table."}}
